about_item: The Perfect Christmas Stocking Stuffer Gift: Bring a relaxing spa moment home with these shower bombs. A thoughtful choice for gifts for women, moms, wives, sisters, girlfriend and best friends, as well as stocking stuffers for teen girls this holiday season.

Aromatherapy Made Simple: Infused with essential oils, 6 shower steamers release aromas as they fizz. Discover 6 scents: Eucalyptus & Menthol, Lavender, Peppermint, Vanilla & Orange, Grapefruit and Watermelon - each individually wrapped.

Made in USA with Natural Essential Oils: Thoughtfully crafted with cruelty-free ingredients and pleasantly strong fragrances, these shower pods bring an indulgent aromatherapy experience and premium self-care into your home.

Relax, Unwind & Recharge: Turn bath steamers into a home-spa ritual for mind & body. Shower the stress away, enjoy daily serenity, unwind in the evening, or start your day with a great mood, energy and an uplifting aroma.

Create Your Own Home Spa: Place one shower fizzy in the corner, away from direct water. Light splashes activate and slowly dissolve the tablet, while warm steam helps disperse its aroma. Breathe deeply and enjoy an easy aromatherapy spa at home.

summary.text: Customers find these shower steamers make a cute gift set and appreciate their relaxation benefits, particularly noting how the lavender ones help with stress relief. The steamers receive mixed feedback regarding their effectiveness, with some saying they work well in the shower while others report they don't work at all. Customers have mixed opinions about the value for money, with some finding them great value while others say they're not worth the price. The steamers' scent and dissolvability receive mixed reviews, with some finding them wonderful while others report very weak scents, and while some say they last the whole shower, others mention they dissolve too quickly.
